candidates.title: Every Microsecond Matters: Achieving Near Speed-of-Light Latency in GPU Collectives
candidates.reason: decode-heavy長文脈LLM推論でcritical pathとなるsmall GPU collectivesを対象に、barrier-free synchronization・symmetric memory・multicast等でscale-up collective latencyのhardware下限へ近づけるsystems研究。推論network/runtimeの重点隣接領域として価値が高い。

candidates.title: Autopoiesis: A Self-Evolving System Paradigm for LLM Serving Under Runtime Dynamics
